name: Only You and Me
source:
María arrives with her child at a small town in the middle of nowhere, hoping her past won't be stubborn enough to follow them. However, she slowly comes to realize that things won’t be so easy.

[From [url=https://ma-ka.itch.io/only-you-and-me]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
玛丽亚带着孩子来到一个偏僻的小镇，希望她的过去不会顽固地追随他们。然而，她慢慢发现事情不会那么容易。

[来自[url=https://ma-ka.itch.io/only-you-and-me]Itch.io[/url]]
